activation.note: Activation targets train definitions, including edits unrelated to identity and documents with incorrect locations or filenames. Path and field presence are explicitly discovery signals rather than necessary scope conditions; auxiliary and reference-only files are excluded. Content inspection and semantic classification are honestly labeled needs_new_observer and llm_judged.

audit.summary: All thirteen segments survive at their claimed destinations. Title Case and flat file placement remain explicitly mandatory despite placement in prefer, while then contains the typed-identity obligation alone; additional rationale, scope clarification and detector detail are declared. No shared-node relocation, unauthorized waiver or application-specific overfitting is present.

segmentChecks.note: The source name remains explicitly recorded in audit, while the rewritten identity title conveys the same train-naming subject.
The typed train_id is mandatory in then; Title Case and flat plan/_trains/{train_id}.yaml placement are explicitly mandatory in prefer and reinforced by avoid and evidence.
verifier_detail[3] retains that train_naming covers train_id, title, and file naming.
then retains the train:{subject}:{descriptive-name} form and kebab-case requirement; the verifier regex and avoid entries preserve enforceable detail.
Title Case remains an explicit mandatory requirement in prefer[1], with matching avoidance and verification text.
The exact flat path template is mandatory in prefer[0]; nesting, external placement, and filename mismatch are prohibited.

risks: Title Case is not algorithmically defined for edge cases such as acronyms, minor words, or hyphenated titles, so capitalization could vary there; the ordinary decision is nevertheless clear.

unobservable: Whether a candidate YAML declares its own top-level train_id currently needs a new content observer.
Whether a YAML file's purpose is to define one train rather than serve as an auxiliary, registry, or reference-only file is explicitly llm_judged and cannot be decided by Datalog facts alone.

review.summary: All six knowledge-rich segments independently checked are preserved, and no dropped, shared, or auditor-rejected segments require further adjudication. The coder-facing rule makes the identity, title, and flat-path requirements clear and mandatory. Activation is well scoped but not fully Datalog-deterministic because candidate content inspection and final train-document classification require additional observation or judgment.
